rationale: This is a mechanical recombination of two archive components — the identical WINSOR(DELTA(act-che)/at) accrual term from "Noncash Asset Build Value Trap" (which was already weak at fmb -1.76, t-alpha -1.09) bolted onto the identical IND_RANK EBITDA-yield leg from "Maturity-Extension Operating Value" — so it is a cosmetic value-proxy swap rather than a new mechanism, and the accrual leg itself is close to the published working-capital accrual anomaly.

Changing the scaler of short-term debt from total liabilities to current liabilities is a pure denominator tweak on "Maturity-Extension Operating Value," whose evidence was insignificant on both metrics (fmb 1.13, t-alpha 1.24), so this is a cosmetic variant unlikely to change the diagnosis rather than a substantively different test.

The stated diagnosis is that all-positive value×liquidity composites deliver strong FMB slopes purely from an unconditional value tilt with negative FF5 alpha, yet the proposal reproduces exactly that structure (IND_RANK ≥ 0 multiplied by TS_RANK ≥ 0, as in "Liquid Sales Bargain"), so the conditioning term cannot change sign and the signal will again be dominated by the sales-yield leg.

The second-difference leverage term is economically distinct from the one-period DELTA(lt) and peak-distance leverage variants already in the archive, and the signed distress leg correctly makes the composite a two-sided conditional consistent with the negative expected sign, though ACCEL on annual data will be noisy.

This is close to the archive's "Continuously Health-Weighted Cash Yield" (which failed) with the yield numerator swapped from oancf to dvc and the re/at term flipped, and conditioning on dividend payers with accumulated deficits selects a thin, unstable subgroup that will drive the long leg with poor coverage.

Fundamental-earnings volatility is a genuinely different distress channel from the levels, trends, leverage and liquidity terms already tested, and the industry z-scored, sign-centered construction properly makes book cheapness an amplifier rather than a standalone value tilt; the main weakness is that a 3-period VOL estimate is a very noisy volatility proxy and earnings volatility on its own is a documented anomaly.
